headers._comment: Derivative filenames carry a content hash, so a changed photo gets a new URL and these can be cached forever. Same for the self-hosted fonts, whose filenames are stable by family/weight/subset.

Display images and the profile photo keep their original filenames, so they can be replaced in place. A day at full speed, then a week of serving the cached copy while refreshing in the background. Paths are mutually exclusive with the rules above so precedence never matters.
